status: BLOCKED: NVBit trace output non-functional on current environment
source_artifact: NVBit v1.7.6 tracer tested with compiled CUDA (l1_bw_32f) and PyTorch (BERT-base)
provenance: Multiple test runs on RTX 5090 (sm_120) with driver 580.105.08

smoke_test_results.failure_stage: NVBit trace output — kernel callback never writes files
smoke_test_results.failure_reason: NVBit v1.7.6 loads (banner confirmed, USER_DEFINED_FOLDERS honored), binary runs correctly (L1 bandwidth reported), but no .pb/.csv files are written to TRACES_FOLDER or default traces/ directory. Same binary+env produced traces on 2026-04-12. The 'Traces location is ...' printf from tracer_tool.cu:1015 never appears, indicating the kernel-launch callback that sets up trace output is not reached.

smoke_test_results.failure_stage: Same as control — NVBit trace output path
smoke_test_results.failure_reason: Identical behavior to l1_bw_32f control. BERT inference runs correctly (output shape confirmed), NVBit loads (banner confirmed), no trace files generated.

environment.nvbit_output_code_reference: tracer_tool.cu:1006-1024 — statsFile fopen/fprintf/fclose at kernel launch

rodinia-nn.status: available — previously used for instrumentation validation

resolution: NVBit v1.7.6 kernel-launch callback does not trigger trace file output on current driver (580.105.08). This is environment-level, not code-level. Existing traces from April 12 can be used for control validation. Fresh claim-bearing trace generation requires either: debugging the NVBit callback path, updating NVBit, or rolling back the driver.
